summary: Verified UniversalPlayerCard component across all Dashboard sections (War Zone, Safe Haven, Front Lines) and Command Post. All tier-based styling (DEMON=red, GOBLIN=green, STANDARD=amber) working correctly. Backend APIs return correct data structures with baseline_stats.

issues: L5/L10/SZN hit rates showing 0 - known data issue from cached board, not a code bug

war_zone_endpoint.description: /api/v3/war-zone returns picks with tier_label=DEMON, fg_pct, fg3_pct, stl, blk from vault

safe_haven_endpoint.description: /api/v3/safe-haven returns picks with tier_label=GOBLIN, fg_pct, fg3_pct, stl, blk from vault

command_profile_endpoint.description: /api/command/profile/{name} returns baseline_stats with PTS, REB, AST, FG%, 3P%, STL, BLK

pick_data_structure.description: Picks have player_name, team, stat_type, line, tier_label, h10_rate, season_avg, diff_from_avg

war_zone_demon_styling.description: War Zone cards have red glow/border (border-red-500/50, bg-gradient from-red-950/60)

safe_haven_goblin_styling.description: Safe Haven cards have green glow/border (border-green-500/50, bg-gradient from-green-950/60)

front_lines_styling.description: Front Lines cards display with appropriate tier-based styling

universal_player_card_display.description: Cards display player name, team, stat type, line, and tier badge (DEMON/GOBLIN)

hit_rate_and_avg_display.description: Cards display L10: 0% (data issue) and Avg values

diff_from_avg_indicator.description: Cards display diff_from_avg percentage with green (negative/favorable) or red (positive/unfavorable) indicators

command_post_player_profile.description: UniversalPlayerCard in Command Post displays SEASON STATS with PTS, REB, AST, FG%, 3P%, STL, BLK (verified with Jaime Jaquez Jr.: PTS 8.5, REB 4.3, AST 2.5, FG% 46.0%, 3P% 30.8%, STL 0.9, BLK 0.2)

quick_add_functionality.description: Quick Add button (+) opens Command Post and adds leg to configuration

player_card_click_navigation.description: Clicking card navigates to PlayerDetailPage showing all props with tier badges

war_zone_card_classes.result: 10 cards found with classes: 'border-red-500/50 bg-gradient-to-br from-red-950/60'

safe_haven_card_classes.result: 10 cards found with classes: 'border-green-500/50 bg-gradient-to-br from-green-950/60'

command_post_vault_stats.result: Found vault stats with content: PTS 8.5, REB 4.3, AST 2.5, FG% 46.0%, 3P% 30.8%, STL 0.9, BLK 0.2

diff_from_avg_badges.result: 10+ diff_from_avg indicators found (green for favorable, red for unfavorable)

critical_code_review_comments: UniversalPlayerCard.jsx correctly implements tier-based theming via TIER_THEMES config
VaultStatsRow component correctly displays BDL stats (PTS, REB, AST, FG%, 3P%, STL, BLK) with proper formatting
Dashboard.jsx correctly uses UniversalPlayerCard with mode='compact' in War Zone, Safe Haven, Front Lines sections
CommandPost.jsx correctly uses UniversalPlayerCard for profile display with full baseline_stats
picks_getter_service.py correctly populates fg_pct, fg3_pct, stl, blk from master hub via _get_player_stats()
test_credentials: Demo mode at /demo - no login required
context_for_next_testing_agent: UniversalPlayerCard tested across all Dashboard sections. DEMON=red glow, GOBLIN=green glow, STANDARD=amber glow. Command Post profile shows full BDL stats. Quick Add works. L10 showing 0% is a known data issue from dg_cached_board, not a code bug. PlayerDetailPage shows all props with tier badges. NBA CDN images may fail (HTTP2 protocol error) - external issue, cards fallback to team logos or initials.
